transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get our surge huddle started. We all know the situation: we're at 10 of 12 beds right now, and we're expecting increased pediatric respiratory volume tomorrow. The good news is we have that unused observation wing with eight bays available. Under our surge policy, we need to accommodate all six forecasted monitored-observation patients simultaneously in the observation wing during the 07:00 to 13:00 window — and the main ED can't hold overflow during that time. So activating fewer than six bays isn't an option. I'd like to hear from each of you on staffing, facilities readiness, and bed management so we can finalize the operating plan. Who wants to start?

The staffing roster confirms that exactly two pediatric RNs and one respiratory therapist can cover the observation wing from 07:00 through 19:00 tomorrow.
